title: An Empirical Study of Counterfactual Self-Explanations in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.17119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can easily generate explanations for their own outputs, but such self-explanations are not necessarily faithful to the model's behavior. We study this issue through counterfactual self-explanations, where a model minimally edits an input so that its own prediction changes. Across sentiment analysis and natural language inference, we evaluate ten instruction-tuned models from the LLaMA-3 and Qwen-2.5 families, measuring faithfulness, minimality, and alignment with human-annotated rationales. Our results show that model scale is the strongest determinant of explanation quality: larger models are substantially more likely to generate counterfactuals that flip their own predictions and target decision-relevant evidence. In contrast, the rationale-guided condition produces edit-minimal counterfactuals that are also more human-aligned. However, it does not consistently improve faithfulness. translated_title: 大语言模型中反事实自我解释的实证研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可以轻松地为其自身的输出生成解释，但这类自我解释并不一定忠实于模型的真实行为。我们通过反事实自我解释来研究这一问题，即模型对输入进行最小限度的编辑，从而使自身的预测发生改变。在情感分析和自然语言推理任务上，我们评估了来自LLaMA-3和Qwen-2.5系列的十个指令微调模型，测量了忠实性、最小性以及与人工标注理由的一致性。我们的结果表明，模型规模是解释质量的最强决定因素：更大的模型明显更有可能生成能翻转自身预测并针对决策相关证据的反事实。相比之下，理由引导的条件能够产生编辑最小且与人类更一致的反事实，但它并不能持续地提升忠实性。总体而言，反事实自我解释……
tldr: 该论文通过对LLaMA-3和Qwen-2.5系列共十个指令微调模型的实证研究发现，模型规模是反事实自我解释质量的最强决定因素，而理由引导虽能提升编辑最小性和与人类标注的一致性，却无法持续提高忠实性。
en_tdlr: This empirical study of ten instruction-tuned models from the LLaMA-3 and Qwen-2.5 families finds that model scale is the strongest determinant of counterfactual self-explanation quality, while rationale guidance improves edit-minimality and human alignment but does not consistently improve faithfulness.
